personality_one_liner: A friendly, touchable, and approachable community launcher that feels welcoming and highly focused.

spacing.rule: Generous spacing. Use chunky margins to make elements feel like touchable objects.

do's: Use blur on the FAB/close button when over the webview
Use subtle glass overlay if text is overlaid on the community image
dont's: Don't blur the primary Buvette CTA; it needs to be solid, opaque, and chunky.

screens.name: Home
screens.purpose: A single, highly focused launch screen that welcomes the user and presents one clear action.

states.loading: Centered loading spinner with the brand color
states.error: Message: 'Impossible de charger l'application', Retry button

screens.layout: Center the layout perfectly. Place a beautiful, large hero image (community gathering) inside a chunky rounded container (radius `lg`, shadow 2) with generous `xl` outer padding. Below the image, center the title 'Mon Association' in large `2xl` Figtree font. Place the primary CTA 'Buvette' in the bottom thumb zone, sticky above the safe area, spanning 100% width (minus padding). The button should be chunky (min height 56pt, radius `pill`) and solid `brandPrimary`.

screens.name: BuvetteWebView
screens.purpose: In-app browser to display the HelloAsso campaign.

states.error: Message: 'Impossible de charger la page HelloAsso', Retry button

screens.layout: Full screen `react-native-webview`. Add a floating Back/Close button (Glass or solid `surfaceInverse`) in the top right or top left safe area to allow the user to easily return to the Home screen.

hero_community.alt: A group of people standing around each other in a community gathering

instructions_to_main_agent: Install `react-native-webview` and ensure it takes up flex 1 on the WebView screen.
Implement the Home screen exactly as a single-action micro-app: hero image -> big title -> massive sticky CTA.
Use `Figtree` for the display font ('Mon Association' title) and `Nunito` for the button and body text.
Follow the Tactile/Playful personality: buttons should be pill-shaped, chunky, and have a slight press overshoot animation if possible.
Do NOT use any blue, indigo, or purple colors. The color palette relies on warm cream and vibrant coral (`#DE6B48`).
Include a prominent 'Close' button overlaid on the WebView so users can return to the Home screen.
Ensure touch targets are at least 56pt high for the primary CTA.
